title: Mod Base Pack
description: A package containing commonly used mods that does not alter the gameplay; you can add custom mods on top of this.
body: A ready‑to‑use foundation pack that bundles the most commonly needed utility mods—the ones you would otherwise have to add manually every time you install gameplay mods. It deliberately leaves the vanilla experience untouched: no new items, mechanics, or world changes. Its whole purpose is to save you the hassle of hunting down the same performance fixes, bug patches, UI improvements, and required libraries whenever you want to try a new set of content mods. Just use this pack as your clean starting point, then drop any custom gameplay mods (adventure, tech, magic, etc.) directly on top, and you’re ready to play.
